typeSettings.typesIntro: Manage your own attendance types. You can set individual names, a default status, rehearsal templates and start and end times, and configure attendance for specific groups only.
typeSettings.activeHelper: If you disable this option, the type is no longer offered when creating attendance.
typeSettings.songsHelper: If you enable this option, you can add pieces when creating attendance of this type; they are relevant for upcoming rehearsals and automatically included in the rehearsal plan.
